precedence: selected project handoff and latest user-edited source

defaults.shading: smooth with geometry supporting rounded silhouette
defaults.symmetry: local sagittal anatomy, paired eyes and markings; explicit decorative exceptions
defaults.eye_authority: latest user-approved live source; OnlyModel fallback

palette.layout: existing atlas regions; inspect flat base-color patches
palette.scope: All in-scope SAP render models, including pets and associated props; only explicit user override permits another texture.

uv.padding_policy: Measure and report pixel padding for the chosen atlas patches and filtering; no fixed generated-palette margin.

wireframe_evidence.scope: SAP/Craftland pets and associated props in the current task
wireframe_evidence.when_mesh_exists: matched clean and actual evaluated/final triangle wireframe previews
wireframe_evidence.when_concept_only: matched proposed-topology companion, explicitly labeled NO MESH YET

reproducibility.exact_existing_asset: transfer the selected mesh, textures and settings with hashes; do not regenerate
reproducibility.new_ai_design: style and acceptance criteria can be standardized; identical geometry or pixels are not guaranteed
reproducibility.render_comparison: same saved camera, size, world, lights, engine, seed and color management; record device/version differences

atlas.policy: Use unchanged primary AllPets image for new pets and UV/material work; share image across selected pets.

palette.layout: approximately equal-area used-color regions covering full canvas
palette.activation: Only when explicitly requested, or when auditing a historical generated-palette fixture.

supplied.source_sha256: verify when supplied; report if not checked
